dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitting the trailing edge boundary from the posterior dorsal ridge to the acute apex, indicating moderate falcation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 0.7:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a constant radius across the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Abbreviated proportional length relative to thickness, extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the melon-rostrum transition point.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast horizontal demarcation line between the dark dorsal and light ventral regions extending from the rostrum through the flank.
